pr_title: Gray out and stop player instances who quit during multi-spectator sessions
pr_body:
Closes #14322 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/130762942-199c6ed2-7330-4104-8849-3addde297891.mp4

Visual feedback is welcomed, I'm not 100% sure about the way I currently have it, but it seems mostly good for the time being.
pr_comments: I'm fairly certain you also need to change `SpectatorPlayer` to not exit on a new play.
It's a bit out-of-scope from this PR, but I'll see if it's a simple change and push it here.

I've resolved this by separating the offending logic to a separate `SoloSpectatorPlayer` to be for `SoloSpectator` only, for the time being. I could've gone for a simple overridable property to avoid this behaviour in multi, but since `SoloSpectator` is a thing already and this logic is pretty much solo-specific, I went with subclassing.

issue_context.title: Remove left player instances from the multi-spectator view
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** Remove the box of the players that quit the match

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![lazerspectator](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53081750/129493311-4e392ad1-a460-4f07-8e9a-95ee518905dc.png)
comments: Weird, I actually had one screen disappear and thought it was due to a player leaving... but must have been some other issue.
It'll disappear if the player leaves and starts playing again, it's just how `SpectatorPlayer` works currently.

While I was looking at implementing this, I got concerned about how the grid should behave when a player exits, should the cell get removed, or should it fade out?

Here are videoes showing the two different effects applied, for reference:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/130745799-fc05d3f2-c58c-440e-8fd6-19fc36153041.mp4

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/130745437-f35a4b3e-1ade-46a3-91b9-adcc97bdaae9.mp4

Graying out might be good to still preserve the left player's areas (not as if they haven't even joined), but removing completely would be good if there were more than 16 players playing at once and some of them have left, not sure.
It should remain in place. Colour to gray sounds good, don't use alpha please.

review_comments: it's test code so I won't pick on it too much, but the indices are recomputed 3 times in 6 lines, the last time even manually instead of calling the same method again
Are you 100% sure this will always find a result? `RemoveUser` above gracefully handles the case where `userId` is not tracked, so it's best to make sure. Or use `SingleOrDefault` for safety.

`instances` gets loaded with all the players on BDL (also `leaderboard` which is accessed below), and [calls to `EndGameplay` are scheduled](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/a503274e1d79e40bea8a85e9c4e8f45529822b61/osu.Game/Screens/Spectate/SpectatorScreen.cs#L135-L147), so it should be safe to access it directly:
